xpath.div:
Start a new payroll month: select year/month → Set up payroll period → Manual entry / attendance → Quick payroll calculation.
Need help? Open Manual entry guide for the next month below.

details.summary: Manual entry guide for the next month

div.p: Example: November 2026. Use confirmed November attendance and amounts. A new month does not automatically copy the previous month attendance, bonuses or payroll.

ol.li:
Select the month and employees.
Select Company, Year and Month above. Leave Employee blank for the whole company or select one employee. Click Refresh monthly data after changing filters.

Create a period if the month has none.
Click Set up payroll period. Check the first/last date of the month, standard working days, hours per day and the correct regional minimum wage for unemployment insurance. Save, return and click Refresh monthly data. Reuse an existing period instead of creating a duplicate.
Employees need an active contract, salary structure and base salary. Use a new contract/addendum for lasting contract changes; do not re-enter base salary every month.

Record daily attendance.
Click Manual entry / attendance, check the company, period and employee, select Attendance, then enter the work date and hours. For example, enter 8 for eight hours on 02/11/2026. Use 0 only for confirmed zero hours, not for unknown data.
Use a stable employee-and-date source ID such as NV001-20261102. Start at revision 1. Enter an approval reference / correction reason, then click Validate and save. Confirm the batch is Saved; review rejected rows and logs before continuing.
Repeat for each date and employee. Return to Refresh monthly data, then Attendance grid, days 01–31 to review the month.

Enter performance, bonuses or salary components.
Click Manual entry / attendance, select Performance or Salary component, choose a component in the contract salary structure and enter the amount. Use a stable employee/component/month source ID such as NV001-202611-KPI, revision 1 and an approval reason.
Click Validate and save and review the results/log. If performance is required and a zero amount is confirmed, enter 0 for the appropriate component. Do not re-enter Excel amounts through a separate web source; this can conflict or double-count.

Check and calculate payroll.
Click Refresh monthly data. Check paid days, performance, contract salary and each employee status. Open Set up payroll period and 3. Check data to find missing information.
Select an employee or leave blank for all, then click Quick payroll calculation. Resolve missing contracts, attendance or performance first. Base salary comes from the contract. Employee insurance reduces net pay; employer insurance is shown separately.

Review payslips and download Excel.
Click Refresh monthly data after calculation. Open each Payslip or Excel-style payroll to check components, insurance, deductions and net pay. Click Export payroll Excel for the selected month. A selected employee limits this export to that person; clear the employee to export the company.
The Export entire month to Excel button on the 52-column grid or payslip always exports the whole month.

Correct data and review history.
Before calculation: create a new manual entry with the same source ID, date/component and a higher revision (2, 3, etc.). Enter the reason. Saved entries cannot be edited directly. Correct Excel inputs through their original Excel source and revision.
After calculation: open Set up payroll period, enter a reopening reason and click Reopen for correction and recalculation. Save the correction and run Quick payroll calculation. To replace a component amount, open the payslip and Adjust salary, enter the replacement and reason, approve it, then recalculate.
To change a formula: Payslip → Excel formulas → Create new version → select effective dates → Test → Approve version. Approved/finalized periods are locked. Do not overwrite issued payslips.
Change Year/Month to review history. Open Attendance / performance on the employee row to inspect sources and import batch logs, or use Import and payroll logs.

div.p: After entering, correcting or calculating data: return to the correct month and click Refresh monthly data. Change the year when moving from December to January.
